fmv.description: Original fits the full movie in 4:3. Fill fits the full movie to the screen. Both keep its aspect.
plugin.name: Fusion Fix
WFP_PLUGINS_DESCRIPTION: Settings of the Fusion Fix and the other plugins
WFP_PRESET_DESCRIPTION: Pick a preset, then apply it below
WFP_PRESET_APPLY_DESCRIPTION: Sets the values of the preset picked above
WFP_RESTOREDEFAULTS_DESCRIPTION: Sets the settings on this page to their defaults
hudaspect.description: Constrains the HUD to an aspect ratio such as 16:9 or 21:9. Auto uses the whole screen.
fovfactor.description: Multiplies the field of view, which already widens with the screen (Hor+).
cutsceneborders.description: Bars around in-engine cutscenes, which keep their original framing.
instantborders.description: Cutscene borders appear at once instead of sliding in and out.
graphicnovel.description: Whole pages as large as the screen allows, or the original framing.
graphicnovelkey.description: Switches graphic novel pages between filling the screen and the original framing.
borderless.description: A borderless window centered on the screen when the game runs with -window.
antialiasing.description: SMAA smooths the edges of the picture. Needs d3d8to9 and the game’s own anti-aliasing off.
consolegamma.description: Deeper contrast and colors, like GTA IV on the Xbox 360. Needs d3d8to9.
vsync.description: Waits for the display in full screen. Windowed mode never waits.
mousesmoothing.description: The game's smoothing of mouse movement, spread over several frames.
alttab.description: Pause the game while another window is active.
loadsaveslot.description: Skips the main menu and loads a save: a slot number from 0 to 12, or one of the choices.
gamefoldersaves.description: Keeps the saves in the savegames folder of the game.
settingsfile.description: Stores the game's options in settings.ini next to the saves instead of the registry. Enable Saves in Game Folder to keep it in the game's savegames folder. Existing registry settings are copied on first use. Requires a restart.
savestringformat.description: How save names show their date and time (strftime).
windowmode.description: Full screen, a window, or a borderless window covering the screen, at the resolution picked at startup.
animatedborders.description: Cutscene borders slide in and out instead of appearing at once.
fpslimit.description: Limits the frame rate. Very high frame rates can upset the game's physics and scripted events.
gamepadicons.description: Shows controller buttons in prompts and Controls while a controller is in use. Auto follows the connected controller; keyboard and mouse input restores key labels.
skipintro.description: Skips the logo movie at startup.
ConfineCursor.description: Keep the cursor inside the active game window. It is released on focus loss or when disabled.
rawinputmouse.description: Reads relative mouse movement directly, preserving high polling-rate input. The game's sensitivity, invert Y and mouse smoothing settings still apply.
WFP_RESTART_WARNING: Restart the game to apply the changed settings.
checkforupdates.description: Once per start, asks fusionfix.io whether a newer version of the fix is out and tells you in the game. Off makes no network request.
update.availablehub: {name} {version} is available. FusionFixHub opens when you close the game.
gamepadcameraspeed.description: Adjusts the speed of right-stick aiming.
invertgamepady.description: Reverses vertical right-stick aiming independently of mouse inversion.
vibration.description: Enables controller vibration. Turning this off stops any active vibration.
textlanguage.description: Choose the language of plugin settings and help. Automatic uses English. Restart the game after changing this option.
